purpose: A developer asks grumpy to review an MR adding reporting helpers with two real bugs (a division by zero on an empty ledger, a top-N that returns one too many). The review it proposes passes both checks against the MR's diff (it is about the checked commit, every comment sits on a diff line), and the publish code node posts it on the MR as a request for changes.

mr.title: Add reporting helpers over the ledger

notes: An empty ledger divides by zero here
